gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-sans-tc: Noto Sans TC keeps its a, e and s generously open, with curves that flare outward rather than curl shut. Ethnocentric, wide-tracked and fast, sits above it, and the sharp gap between them is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-sans-tel: Noto Sans Telugu rides a high midline with counters that stay linked to the outside, a plain sans to the core. Ethnocentric is built for speed and swagger; this one is built to be read.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-sans-tha: Noto Sans Thaana runs wide channels into each counter and shapes big, open lowercase forms beneath a heading with real attitude. Its friendliness is the strongest card here.

Friendly, rounded lowercase swells like inflated glass beads in the body, while Ethnocentric heads the page with spread-out, aggressive speed. Noto Sans Thai takes over where the heading's drama stops, keeping its round letters open and easy for the sans-serif text.

Noto Sans Thai Looped looks bold in the lowercase because its bodies stand so tall, with spacious gaps at the curve ends. And Ethnocentric, pushed wide and aggressive, makes that plain sans feel even more grounded beneath it.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-sans-tif: Fast up top, puffed-out below. Ethnocentric spreads its short-ascender letters wide, and Noto Sans Tifinagh fills the line with rounded, inflated bowls that stay open and inviting for the sans text.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-sans-tir: Noto Sans Tirhuta reads big and contemporary, its terminals cut back to leave wide gaps around a dominant x-height. Ethnocentric is at its best shouting with speed and spacing, while Noto Sans Tirhuta is at its best simply carrying the words.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-sans-uga: Noto Sans Ugaritic reads snug and friendly, with little step between lowercase and capitals. Its mouths stay open like unjoined chalk arcs, so a long passage would move along easily beneath Ethnocentric's fast, spread-out heading.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-sans-vai: Modern in feel, this body sets words as solid blocks rather than jagged skylines, with generous space between curve ends and stems. A long passage in Noto Sans Vai would flow smoothly beneath Ethnocentric.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-gf-noto-sans-vit: Speed on top, openness below. Noto Sans Vithkuqi gives its a, c, e and s open throats and barely steps up from lowercase to capitals, which tempers Ethnocentric's aggressive, spread-out heading.
